text: What would change the verdict? First, a published calculation connecting parent black hole parameters to a handedness amplitude, scale, or redshift dependence, with a pass or fail range. Or second, a fingerprint only a black hole birth would leave, not merely the broad fact of spin asymmetry. A confirmed spin asymmetry alone would still not test BHU. This route reopens only when a BHU model supplies a calibrated target or a unique signature.
